# Great but…

Fantastic app but the annual subscription price is bonkers particularly when the fantastic content is already free, and annual sub only gets you a few small in-app extras. Annual sub should be half price imo.Update: I think the developer is forgetting who needs who more. We’ll simply move on to another app but they’re trying to make a living, so I highly recommend they lower their crazy annual price before they cease to exist.

Developer Response 03/02/2025

Thank you so much for the support. We should probably limit the free content, as we're barely surviving as a non-profit...
